title: Personal NOC House-Health Wall
dataSources: Daily life scores (`lifescore:daily`), personal SLO status (`personalslo:status`), cross-signal correlations (`correlation:pair`), plus every other `index=personal` sourcetype as input.
app: The meta layer — correlating every `index=personal` feed (sleep, activity, mood, weather, spend, productivity, home telemetry) into daily life scores, personal SLOs, and cross-signal anomaly detection, all computed in Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=personalslo:status category=house
| stats latest(status) as status by system
| eval down=if(status!="ok",1,0)
| sort - down
description: Rolls up every home system — network, energy, security, climate — into one green-or-red status wall.
value: A single house-health wall is the home version of a network operations centre, surfacing any problem at a glance.
implementation: Summarise home-system health into `index=personal`; show a single status board.
visualization: Status wall of home systems, green or red.
grandmaExplanation: It shows all your home systems on one board, green when fine and red when something needs attention.
